title: Large Icicles Hanging on House Roof in Winter, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot captured in March 1966 depicting a severe winter snowstorm or freeze. Long, dramatic icicles hang down from the roofline of a residential house above large windows and hedge bushes. Falling snow creates visible streaks across the scene, with a bare dormant tree and adjacent garage building visible in the background.
